paragraphs: Hero cold 4-bet in a spot where Villain was clearly 3-betting too often. He flopped a pair with showdown value and checked. He preserved his equity and induced Villain to bet the turn with worse. This is a great example of what you're trying to accomplish in awkward spots like this.

5-bet pots with post-flop action are very rare. These situations require ultra deep stacks and at least two people crazy enough to 5-bet light and barrel off infinite big blinds. 99% of people aren't spewy enough for that to \happen. As such, | don’t see any need to discuss those situations.
